method: Prioritize second directional departures on currently one-flight pairs. Compare full one/two-stop opportunities and distinct newly connected/faster markets. Jointly reallocate demand before choosing a compatible set. No synthetic weighted score or load-factor forecast.

recommendation.rationale: The two first-priority swaps upgrade PHF-MCI and MCI-SYR from one to two departures each way, have complementary geographic benefits, and pass together. The optional MAX9 adds a third DAY-MCI flight, but a much weaker return and little genuinely new market coverage make it secondary. AD adds fifth DAY-JAX flights and needs a weak JAX-DAY leg to support the package.
